slots.image_prompt: Minimalist abstract geometric composition evoking open-source ideation. A large open book form rendered as thin navy blue linework on a soft off-white background, with delicate golden hairlines branching outward like neural connections or network nodes. Sparse negative space, subtle gradient from pale cream to warm ivory. No text, no letters, no numbers. Ultra-clean editorial aesthetic, high contrast between navy and gold accents on light ground, restrained palette of deep navy #0D2137, warm gold #C08B3E and cool gray #9CA3AF.

Palette: deep navy #0D2137, muted gold #C08B3E, soft gray #9CA3AF on light cream ground. Editorial, sophisticated, breathing room.
